unsupported.title: Unsupported Browser
unsupported.message: This application requires a supported desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Safari). Please access from a desktop computer.

consent.title: Privacy Notice
consent.description: To participate in the interview, you must consent to audio/video recording and processing of your personal data for evaluation purposes. You may withdraw consent at any time. For more information, please see our privacy policy.
consent.accept_aria: I accept the terms and proceed to the interview
consent.decline_aria: I decline and will not proceed to the interview

consent.title: Privacy Notice and Consent
consent.body: To participate in the video interview, you must consent to audio/video recording and the processing of your personal data for evaluation purposes. The recording is used exclusively for competency analysis. You may withdraw consent at any time.

device_check.title: Device Check
device_check.camera_error: Camera not detected or not accessible. Please check your browser permissions.
device_check.mic_error: Microphone not detected or audio level is too low. Try speaking now.

done.title: Interview Completed
done.body: Thank you for participating. Your evaluation is being processed and you will receive the results shortly.

403.title: Session Not Authorized
403.body: The interview session has expired or is no longer available. If you believe this is an error, please contact the recruitment team.

absent_phrase.title: Service Temporarily Unavailable
absent_phrase.body: A technical issue occurred with the interview service. Please contact support for assistance.
